The Specialist will manage relationships with regional research partners, research teams, and technical consultants, ensuring that all regional public goods and knowledge assets align seamlessly with country demands.

Functionally, the Education and Research Specialist will serve as the core technical anchor for Component 1 and Component 2 execution, collaborating closely with the Policy Specialist, M&E Specialist, and country networks to translate empirical evidence into actionable, system-wide basic education policy reforms across the six participating member states (Angola, Comoros, Ethiopia, Madagascar, Malawi, and Mozambique).

A reliable, secure, and user- friendly website is therefore essential for maintaining market confidence, fulfilling transparency obligations, and supporting the ESM’s institutional mandate. The Communications Department leads the day -to-day management of the Website. It coordinates multiple authorised editors (the user management is taken care of the ESM Communications Department) across the organisation who publish and update content on a daily basis. While the Communications Department retains full editorial control and ownership, the ESM has multiple authorised editors who contribute on a daily basis to the Website, publishing and maintaining a wide range of content such as press releases, bond -related information, auction results, newsletters, publications, and other institutional materials. The Website is primarily designed for anonymous users and does not currently include an intranet or extranet area with role- based or restricted-access content. From a technical and operational perspective, the ESM Website is supported by a Drupal -centric cloud-based infrastructure, designed to be scalable, resilient, and secure. The infrastructure supports elastic scaling to accommodate traffic peaks and incorporates industry-standard security controls to mitigate threats such as distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks and other malicious activities. Commissioning: Commissioning is a process that involves the entire Design Team throughout the planning, design, construction and occupancy of the project. Commissioning Guidelines for AOC Projects are contained in the policy statement of June 7, 2010. During the initial planning process, the AOC Project Team shall determine the purpose and role of commissioning. The purpose may be to ensure proper integration of a small renovation/rehabilitation into the Capitol 7 AOC Order 28-8, December 26, 2018 complex, or it may be related to a certification. It may range from simple, direct Owner commissioning by the AOC to an independent Commissioning Agent with a substantial budget. As a rule, if a project is designed by an Associate A/E, then commissioning will be performed by a third party hired by the AOC. Within the context of design for mechanical systems, commissioning plays a significant role. The designer of the mechanical system has these responsibilities: i. Develop and document the Program of Requirements (PoR.) ii. Develop a basis of design. Commissioning shall help ensure that mechanical systems operate properly as a holistic system. The ARB is the official body providing design review for the Office of the Architect of the Capitol, but the Architect of the Capitol retains sole authority for final design approval. ARB review covers planning, design, appearance, and visibility of projects designed by consulting architects, in-house designers, and other parties. ARB review applies to third-party entities, not under contract to, or directly supervised by the Architect of the Capitol including, but not limited to, legislative branch agencies and public utilities. The ARB design review is separate from the technical reviews of consultant-generated contract documents and specifications provided by PPM. 1.5.8.1. Review Criteria: Consistency with the AOC Design Standards, the Capitol Complex Master Plan, and the Preservation Policy and Standards. sla_onsite.text: onID="2.0.2">CRITERION.EXCLUSION.CONVICTIONS.PARTICIPATION_IN_CRIMINAL_ORGANISATION</cbc:CriterionTypeCode> <cbc:Name>Osalemine kuritegelikus organisatsioonis</cbc:Name> <cbc:Description languageID="ET">Kas ettevõtja ise või tema haldus-, juht- või järelevalveorgani liige või isik, kellel on volitused seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on lõpliku süüdimõistva kohtuotsusega süüdi mõistetud kuritegelikus organisatsioonis osalemise eest kõige rohkem viimase viie aasta jooksul või kehtib süüdimõistvas kohtuotsuses sätestatud kõrvalejäämise kohustus endiselt?</cbc:Description> <cac:Legislation> <cbc:ID schemeID="CriteriaTaxonomy" schemeAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" schemeVersionID="2.0.2">c753a2c5-59e6-4970-b6eb-27224e96bf76</cbc:ID> <cbc:Title languageID="ET">RHS § 95 lg 1 p 1 "keda või kelle haldus-, juhtimis- või järelevalveorgani liiget, prokuristi või muud isikut, kellel on volitus seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks. Heastamise võimalus on ettevõtjal juh

esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". staffing_team.text: JA KOGEMUS Pakkuja meeskonnas peavad olema esindatud vähemalt järgmised rollid ja pädevused: 1. projektijuhtimine; 2. ärianalüüs; 3. UX/UI disain. Projektijuhil või vähemalt ühel meeskonnaliikmel peab olema riigihanke algamisele eelneva 5 aasta jooksul omandatud kogemus infosüsteemide ärianalüüsi või teenusedisaini tööde läbiviimisel ning vähemalt ühel meeskonnaliikmel peab olema riigihanke algamisele eelneva 5 aasta jooksul omandatud kogemus minimaalse töötava toote (MVP) või prototüübi arendamisel või kasutajatestimise läbiviimisel. Üks meeskonnaliige võib katta mitut rolli. Pakkuja peab esitama iga meeskonnaliikme kohta vabas vormis CV, millest nähtub isiku haridus, töökogemus ning käesoleva hanke seisukohalt asjakohane pädevus ja kogemus. Pakkuja peab esitama lepingu täitmisse kavandatava meeskonna koosseisu, tuues meeskonnaliikmed nimeliselt välja ning kirjeldades nende rolle, tööjaotust ja vastutusalasid. Pakkuja peab põhjendama, miks kavandatud meeskond on hanke eesmärkide saavutamiseks sobiv ning kuidas meeskonnaliikmete kompetentsid täiendavad üksteist. Esitatud kirjeldust hinnatakse vastavalt hindamismetoodikas kirjeldatud hindamiskriteeriumile „Projekti meeskonna koosseis ja kogemus“. Küsimused ettevõtjale: 1. Selle käigus ei aidata ette valmistada pakkumisi, ei arutata tulevase pakkumise sisu ega avaldata ettevalmistatava hanke tingimusi, mis annaks turukonsultatsioonil osalenutele mistahes eelist. Turukonsultatsioonil saadud nõuannete kasutamisel, sh tulevase konkursi tingimuste kujundamisel arvestatakse mittediskrimineerimise, võrdse kohtlemise ja läbipaistvuse põhimõtetega. Projekti eesmärk Projekti eesmärk on luua ja testida spetsialistidele juhtimislaud a, mis näitab riskirühma laste ohu - ja kaitsemärke reaalajas. Tööriist aitab triaažisüsteemi abil suunata abi õigel ajal õigesse kohta ning hoiab ära olukorra, kus laps jää b ametkondade vahele “nähtamatuks”. Vajalikud andmed koondatakse kokku erinevatest andmebaasidest ning juhtimislaud näitab rollipõhiselt spetsialistidele ainult oma tööks vajalikke andmeid. Juhtimislaud peaks pakkuma lastekaitsetöötajale kinnitamiseks võimalikke sekkumisi ja teenuseid. Oluline on, et tulevikus oleks võimalik vajadusel rolle ja andmeallikaid lisada. Introduction The Administrative Office of the United States Courts (AO) is seeking contractor services for the printing and mailing of the following Internal Revenue Service (IRS) information returns: • W-2, Wage and Tax Statement • 1099-R, Distributions from Pensions, Annuities, Retirement or Profit-Sharing Plans, IRAs, Insurance Contracts, etc. • 1099-INT, Interest Income • 1099-MISC, Miscellaneous Income • 1099-NEC Nonemployee Compensation The printing and mailing support service will allow the Federal Judiciary to accomplish the requirement on the annual IRS tax reporting obligations. This contract will be for printing and mailing services ONLY and DOES NOT include the contractor providing any other tax-related services. The AO will provide ready-to-print and mail Portable Document File (PDF) data files to the contractor with all W-2 and 1099 boxes prepopulated with the appropriate tax information along with appropriate instructions of each tax form. The contractor must have the capability to securely receive and store electronic files from the AO using AO approved encryption methods such as Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) for files in-transit and hard disk encryption for files at-rest. LE: files/Attach_1_-_Blood_Transfusion_Services_SOW.pdf ===== Statement of Work For Transfusion Services 20 October 2026 I. Background: The 88th Medical Group Transfusion Services requires blood components and references lab transfusion testing services. The supplier shall provide blood products and reference blood transfusion services (testing) to support the blood supply in case of emergency situations and inpatient and outpatient care at the WPAFB Medical Center when requested for a period of 5 years at the prices in the approved price list. II. Minimum Technical Requirements: The supplier shall provide blood products and reference transfusion testing that are time dependent with immediate response and expedience to treat critical patients. The supplier must operate 24/7 as the 88th Medical Group (MDG) is a 24/7 operation; this service must be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holidays and weekends. The supplier shall provide rapid shipment of blood products when the 88 MDG Transfusion Services in-house inventory is in need to support critical patients. The one-hour turnaround time for testing is a mission-critical requirement. The blood supplier shall deliver routine blood products ordered on a STAT basis within one (1) hour of the blood sup

eipt of an emergent request for blood products. The required completion point is delivery to the Transfusion Services department. The supplier must fulfill our request with the ordered product with appropriate compatible blood type, applicable testing, and requested quantities. Any unforeseen delays are understandable; however, the ultimate goal is for the delivering agency to aim for the <1 hour delivery time. An appropriate transmittal list is required with each delivery. If emergent requests are unable to be consistently met, it could mean critical failure for our hospital's life-saving capabilities. The supplier shall have 24/7 reference laboratory testing capabilities for patients anticipating transfusions or medical treatment. The supplier must be licensed by the Food & Drug Administration (FDA) and follow American Association of Blood Bank (AABB) standards. The supplier must notify the 88th MDG Transfusion Services of all unexpected/abnormal tests from blood products supplied by them. The supplier shall provide look-back notifications to the 88th MDG as required by 21 CFR 610.48 (b)(3): (a) within three (3) calendar days if blood collected from a donor who tested negative at the time of donation but tests reactive for evidence of HIV or HCV infection on a later do
